name: spira-vibe-edit
description: Review a spira-maxima video in the Spira local editor and make each comment real in its editable, re-rendering locally. The editor's data is kept in ./spira/spira-vibe-edit/; the video and its renders stay in ./spira/spira-maxima/.

cli.name: spira
cli.note: a CLI version with `spira editor --agent` and `--dir`
